# BizForce CRM

> BizForce CRM is customer relationship management software for growing businesses, with contact management, sales pipelines, email follow-ups, workflow automation, and team collaboration.

This file describes the public website. CRM workspaces and customer records require authentication and appropriate organization permissions. Refer to the linked pages for current product details and pricing.

## Product

- [Home](https://bizforce-crm.online/): Product overview.
- [Features](https://bizforce-crm.online/features): CRM capabilities and modules.
- [Pricing](https://bizforce-crm.online/pricing): Plans and pricing.
- [Integrations](https://bizforce-crm.online/integrations): Supported integrations.

## Help and getting started

- [FAQ](https://bizforce-crm.online/faq): Frequently asked questions.
- [Blog](https://bizforce-crm.online/blog): CRM articles and guides.
- [Contact](https://bizforce-crm.online/contact): Contact the sales and support team.
- [Sign up](https://bizforce-crm.online/signup): Create an account.
- [Sign in](https://bizforce-crm.online/login): Access an existing account.

## Policies

- [Privacy policy](https://bizforce-crm.online/privacy-policy): How information is handled.
- [Terms of service](https://bizforce-crm.online/terms): Terms for using BizForce CRM.
- [Cookie policy](https://bizforce-crm.online/cookie-policy): Cookie information.
- [Refund policy](https://bizforce-crm.online/refund-policy): Refund terms.
